Since a grid point must be used, draw the apex at the grid point 2 rows up and at column 4 (or column 3), giving sides of equal length only if the apex is placed at column 3.5. Equivalently, draw an isosceles triangle with vertices A, B, and the point 2 rows above the midpoint of AB, so the two new sides from A and B to the apex are equal in length.
